propositions: Pure intercepts like verify-commit-ticket can skip the store mount step because they dispatch before ensure_initialized, causing ticket resolution to fail with 'ticket store not found'

The mount logic (ensure_initialized with init_only=True and _create_tracker) is replicated across dispatch arms and absent from intercept paths, creating structural vulnerability to missed initialization
A single central CLI choke point must enforce store mount before both pure intercepts and set-based dispatch, except for commands with policy=none (init, scratch, explain, pure no-store reads)
REBAR_TRACKER_DIR override must bypass the central mount gate without side effects, preserving library and MCP behavior
Per-arm ensure_initialized calls may remain as idempotent re-mounts but cannot substitute for the centralized gate guarantee
